agent_responses.message: Hello! I'm Ponte Idiomas' virtual assistant. Would you like to explore our courses, or do you already have one in mind?
How much does beginner English cost?
I will check the prices in our current catalog.

The beginner English course is in person, with classes on Tuesdays and Thursdays from 19:00 to 20:00. The monthly fee is two hundred and twenty reais, and it lasts six months. Would you like to know anything else about this course?
Oh, okay, two hundred and twenty. Now help me with something else—I've never studied English, I want to learn for travel, I prefer in-person classes, and I'm available Tuesday and Thursday evenings.
That 19:00 to 20:00 time works for me, yes. Is there a class available?

The beginner English course fits what you are looking for well: it is in person, for people who have never studied, and the classes are exactly on Tuesdays and Thursdays from 19:00 to 20:00. As for places, I cannot confirm availability, because that depends on the school office, which is open Monday through Friday, from 09:00 to 18:00. Can I help you with anything else?
Okay, that was exactly what I needed to know. Thanks, goodbye!
Thank you for contacting Ponte Idiomas. See you next time!

messages: Criterion 1 passed: The agent answered R$ 220 per month to the initial question about the cost of beginner English. After the user's change of intent (wanting to learn English from scratch, in person, on Tuesdays and Thursdays), the agent began guiding the selection of a compatible course. Both requirements were met.

Criterion 2 passed: The agent recommended in-person beginner English, consistent with the level (never studied before) and stated days (Tuesdays and Thursdays). It did not repeat questions already answered. The data (in person, Tuesdays and Thursdays, 19:00 to 20:00) matches the queried catalog.

Criterion 3 passed: The agent did not promise a place, enrollment or booking. When asked about available classes, it stated that it could not confirm availability and directed the user to contact the school office. The response was appropriate and contained no improper promises.
